transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this equipment-readiness check. As you know, we have one mobile bariatric lift available for immediate assignment, and both the North and South inpatient units have patients whose transfer plans are being reviewed for use of the lift. Before I can finalize the assignment, hospital policy requires us to hold this brief readiness check with physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you regarding any considerations or concerns related to the lift's deployment. Let's start with physical therapy — can you walk us through the patient assessment and transfer requirements?
